info.description: Delegated personal OAuth, code + PKCE S256, explicit resource and consent. Not an autonomous organization identity. Read-only POSTs may be repeated; keyset pages are not a snapshot. Decimal money remains a string. Never generate a new commandId after a timeout. Refresh once per connection; atomically persist the rotated token. Reuse, lost refresh responses and grant expiry require reconnect. Consent defaults to 7 days; 30/90/365 days require explicit client policy. Consumed refresh proofs use capped encrypted buckets, never eviction of live evidence. Capacity exhaustion rejects new grants or exchanges. A 30-day idle limit never extends consent. Access tokens live at most 300 seconds. OAuth 2.1 and Idempotency-Key are drafts; no FAPI compliance claim. API data uses no-store. Runtime cross-field refinements remain mandatory.
